_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.20.1 fabric. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/mv-1.20.1-fabric, an independent architectury-loom build in this repository) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test. The harness build stages the two jars under test into the run's mods/ folder itself (production fabric jars are intermediary-named; fabric-loader's dev-mode remapper brings them into the run's namespace) and resolves the run's fabric-api itself — through a plain (non-mod) configuration, because loom 1.1 cannot read any MC 1.20.1 fabric-api from 0.91.1 on (the Fabric-Loom-Mixin-Remap-Type manifest key): it compiles against 0.91.0+1.20.1 and stages the pinned 0.92.12+1.20.1 into the same mods/. So jech, jei and fabric-api all carry via=dev-classpath: there is nothing for jt to stage. The row is a harness row since this move (2026-10-15): it declares no ready_when and no world, because the harness's own runner creates and pins its flat level (and so reaches the JEI storage marker JEI 15 defers to level load, which is why the row keeps that check) and quits the client when the selection is done. daemon_java is 17 because the harness wrapper is Gradle 8.1.1, which cannot run on the machine's default JDK (JBR 25). Upstream's two fabric pins stay corrected the way the checkout corrected them: loader 0.16.14 (the pinned jei 15.48.0.179 requires fabricloader >=0.16.3) and the api split above.
